gloss: to hold in one's arms, to have (problems)

definitions.gloss: to hold in one's arms, to carry
definitions.explanation: To hold something against one's body.

definitions.gloss: to have, to be burdened with
definitions.explanation: To have problems, debts, or staff.

notes:
{抱|かか}える is an ichidan verb with both physical and figurative meanings.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the object held or borne

ASPECT (ている):
{抱|かか}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is holding" (physical) or "has / is burdened with" (figurative).

PHYSICAL USE (to hold in arms):
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to carry luggage in one's arms
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to hold a baby
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to hug one's knees

FIGURATIVE USE (to have, to be burdened with):
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to have problems
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to be burdened with debt
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to have anxiety
- ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to have worries
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}える: to have employees (on staff)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{抱|だ}く→抱く：02131_daku⟧ AND ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧:
- ⟦{抱|だ}く→抱く：02131_daku⟧ means to hug or embrace, with the arms wrapped around someone.
- ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ is the ordinary word for holding something in the hand.
- {抱|かか}える is holding something bulky against the body with the arms, and is the only one of the three used for bearing burdens figuratively.
